capabilities.why: Opening an ODS needs the Calc document shell, the ODS importer, the document model and the LOK part/tile entry points.  A core built with --with-wasm-module=writer has none of them: the module's directories are not even in the build.  This asks whether the objects that ARE that capability exist, are linked, and are registered; it does not claim to have opened a spreadsheet.
